name: Vvaw
description: Vvaw was a planet located in the Vvaw system, a part of the Calaron sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Jedi Master Jmmaar, a member of the Viraanntesse species that originated in the Expansion Region's Viraanntesse system, hailed from Vvaw.
lead_paragraphs: Vvaw was a planet located in the Vvaw system, a part of the Calaron sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Jedi Master Jmmaar, a member of the Viraanntesse species that originated in the Expansion Region's Viraanntesse system, hailed from Vvaw.
